tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__resize_window
tools.description: Emulate a viewport size in the Browser pane tab. Presets: mobile (375x812), tablet (768x1024), or desktop, which clears the size emulation and returns the tab to the pane's own responsive size. Custom sizes need both width and height. An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. The desktop app may also clear a size you set when your turn ends, so set it again in a later turn if you still need it. A size the user picked from the pane's own Viewport menu is theirs and stays until they or you change it; leave it unless they ask. colorScheme (light/dark) emulates prefers-color-scheme on that tab; it survives reloads and preset "desktop" does not touch it, but the pane re-syncs the tab to the app's light/dark theme when that theme changes or the pane reopens; local documents and static HTML previews always render light. The mobile preset (and any width < 768) also emulates a mobile device: Android Chrome user agent and 5 touch points, so pages detect a touch phone; your clicks still arrive as mouse clicks. Reload the page after switching so load-time device gates re-run.

Exit code 1
# Tâche : MM-03.3 — jalon 1, passe 5 (finitions : stockage statique, forme vide, arènes dans Reachable)

## Git
Même branche `formal/access_model_0.1`, à la suite. Pas de merge, pas de PR. Tout sous `formal/`. `Ern/MM02.lean` inchangé. Spec jointe : MM-03.3 v0.2, non copiée ; arbitrages A1–A11, B1–B10, C1–C9 en vigueur ; les arbitrages ci-dessous les complètent et font foi.

## Langue
Code, docstrings, commentaires, messages de commit en anglais. Rapport en français.

## Arbitrages (font foi)
D1. Stockage statique. `S3.init statics`, `statics` au même encodage que les locaux de `enterFrame`, plus l'état initial de chaque feuille (`Init` pour une globale avec initialiseur, `Uninit` sinon). Emplacements possédés par le cadre de base 0, une racine `Modify` par emplacement racine, détenue par le cadre 0. Le cadre 0 ne sort jamais. `StaticPinnedBottom` porte sur ce stockage. Un cadre appelé n'exerce une racine du cadre 0 que par un paramètre dérivé (A2, A3) ; aucune règle d'accès supplémentaire. Le MMIO est représenté comme stockage statique épinglé : les tests vérifient la discipline d'accès, pas la sémantique d'un accès matériel (effets de lecture, modifications externes), qui reste hors du noyau et doit être dite telle dans les docstrings.
D2. `alloc` rejette la forme vide : `shape ≠ []` dans la précondition statique. Une allocation de taille nulle est une forme à une feuille ; sa correspondance avec MM-02 relève du jalon 2.
D3. Arènes dans `Reachable`.
  - L'état porte une liste d'entrées d'arène `{storage, internal}` : `storage` est l'emplacement du stockage administré, `internal` l'autorité qui l'administre. Le propriétaire n'est pas stocké : c'est celui de `storage`, qui suit les transferts (A5).
  - Une arène est vivante ssi `internal` est active. `ArenaInv` est exigé pour toute arène vivante ; une entrée dont `internal` est libérée n'est soumise à rien et ne peut plus servir à `issue` ni `reset`.
  - `newArena storage : ok | reject` enregistre une arène. Préconditions : `Modify` exerçable sur `storage` ; `storage` utilisable ; aucune arène vivante n'a déjà ce stockage. `internal` est l'autorité `Modify` détenue par le propriétaire de `storage` et couvrant exactement son empreinte : sa racine si `storage` est une racine allouée, l'autorité de bloc si `storage` est un bloc émis par une autre arène (arène imbriquée).
  - Arènes imbriquées : l'`internal` de l'enfant est dérivé de celui du parent ; `ResetPre` du parent (aucune autorité active dérivée de son `internal`) refuse donc le `reset` tant que l'enfant vit. Aucune clause supplémentaire.

/-- Preconditions of `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, O4), in order: source usable (MM-03.3.1) and
1 initialised; 2 destination usable, without an `Init` leaf, sharing no leaf with the source,
and still usable once it owns the source's storage (no ownership cycle); exercisable `Modify`
on the source and on the destination (B2); 4 no active derived
access on the source other than those it holds; 5 anchors of the value valid; 6 non-escape
(MM-03.3.6) towards the destination's frame, for the anchors of the value and of the usable
places it owns, whose frame changes with it (A5), each frame read after the transfer (B7);
7 no leaf of the source pinned, statically
(`Pinned`, MM-03.3.8) or dynamically (A8); B8 on the effective anchor (C1): for every dependent
usable after the transfer, if its effective anchor moves with the value, or if the dependent
itself moves (the destination, or a place the value owns), the frame of the effective anchor is
the dependent's frame or an ancestor of it, both frames read after the transfer
(`EffAnchorOK`). O4.3 holds by construction. -/
def TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
  (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, s.Active x) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src,
    NoEscape (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe dst)) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q,
      (AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) ∨ q = dst ∨ OwnedWithin s src q) →
      EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q))

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) := by
  unfold TransferPre; infer_instance

/-- `transfer` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O4). -/
def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

/-! ## O5 `depend` (MM-03.3 §3) -/

/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (MM-03.3 §3, O5): the anchor joins the dependencies of
the result place; existing dependencies are kept; propagation to containing values is computed
by `depsOf`. -/
def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }

/-- Preconditions of `depend` (MM-03.3 §3, O5), in order: result place usable (MM-03.3.1);
1 valid anchor; 5 non-escape (MM-03.3.6); B3: exercisable `Modify` on the result; C1: the frame
of the effective anchor is the frame of the result or an ancestor of it (`EffAnchorOK`). O5.2
(real origin of the rights or storage) is not representable: the state does not relate a value
to the origin of its content. O5.3 and O5.4 hold by construction. -/
def DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop :=

/-- Preconditions of `endUse p` (A6). Usability of the anchored places is read after the end:
a place that dies with `p` has no usable dependent afterwards. In order: `p` usable;
exercisable `Modify` on `p` (A2);
no active derived authority on an ending leaf, or descending from an authority that the end
releases (MM-03.3 §3, O3.2), held elsewhere than in `p` and staying live; no
usable place anchored on an authority held by `p`, on its root, or held by a holder that dies;
C5: no ending leaf pinned, dynamically (A8) or statically (`Pinned`), whatever `ExternalDone`
says: external obligations end only through `unpin`. The ending leaves include those of the
owned places, which die (A6). C8: `p` itself stays usable, its leaves `Uninit`. -/
def EndUsePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, EndUseAccessOK s p j) ∧

    EndUseAnchorOK s p x) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (p : Nat) :
    Decidable (EndUsePre k s p) := by
  unfold EndUsePre; infer_instance

/-- `endUse` as a relation (A6). -/

  Guarded (EndUsePre k s p) (endUseEff s p)

/-- `StaticPinnedBottom k s` (C5), obligation on the static pinning `K.Pinned`: every leaf covered
by `K.Pinned` belongs to a place owned, transitively, by the base frame, the last of the stack.
Dynamic pinning (`pin`, `unpin`) is not concerned. -/
def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ l, k.Pinned l → ∃ q, l ∈ footprint s.P q ∧ OwnedByFrame s.P (s.F.getLastD 0) q

/-- A place has at most one owning frame (A5). -/
theorem OwnedByFrame.unique {P : List Place} {f g q : Nat} (h : OwnedByFrame P f q)
    (h' : OwnedByFrame P g q) : f = g := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q pl hpl ho =>
    cases h' with
    | frame hpl' ho' => rw [hpl] at hpl'; cases hpl'; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'; rfl
    | place hpl' ho' _ => rw [hpl] at hpl'; cases hpl'; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'
  | @place q o pl hpl ho _ ih =>
    cases h' with
    | frame hpl' ho' => rw [hpl] at hpl'; cases hpl'; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'
    | place hpl' ho' h'' => rw [hpl] at hpl'; cases hpl'; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'; exact ih h''

/-- `static_pinned_never_exits` (C5): under `StaticPinnedBottom`, no frame exit meets a statically
pinned leaf: a place that stops being usable at the exit covers no leaf of `K.Pinned`. -/
theorem static_pinned_never_exits {k : K} {s : S3} {f : Nat} {F₀ : Frames} (hwf : WF3 s)

/-- Right to update the metadata of the arena (A10; C6, aligned with `ProviderRight`): exercisable
`Modify` on the arena value, or an authority `via` exercisable at `Observe` (B2) with a present
effective mode on every metadata leaf, all `SharedMutable` (a `writeShared`, A9), with valid
dependencies. -/
def MetaRight (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (arenaValue s ar) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False ∨
  (s.ExercisableAt via .observe ∧ arenaValue s ar ≠ none ∧
    ∀ l ∈ metaLeaves s ar, effective s via l ≠ none ∧ k.SharedMutable l ∧ DepsValid s l)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (MetaRight k s ar via) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Static preconditions of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right (A10); the
region lies in the storage administered by `internal`; the destination `dst` of the block is
usable, exercisable in `Modify` (A2) and holds no initialised value. -/
def IssueStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧ s.Active ar.internal ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat)
    (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (IssueStatic k s ar via region dst) := by
  unfold IssueStatic; infer_instance

/-- The region is available (MM-03.3 §6): otherwise `issue` fails (A10). -/
def Avail (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ ar.available

instance (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail ar region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance

/-- The abstraction has, through `internal`, effective `Modify` on the region (MM-03.3 §6:
the abstraction has the authority needed to distribute the region). The
disjointness from active emissions is removed (A11): it follows from this right
(`issue_disjoint_redundant`). -/
def IssueRight (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ region, effective s ar.internal l = some .modify

instance (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (IssueRight s ar region) := by
  unfold IssueRight; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): a `Modify` block derived from `internal`
on the region, held by the destination value; the destination and the metadata become `Init`;
the region leaves `available` and joins `issued`. -/
def issueEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 × Arena :=
  ({ s.addAuth ⟨.modify, some ar.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩ with
      I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst ∨ l ∈ metaLeaves s ar then .init else s.I l },
   { ar with
      available := ar.available.filter fun l => decide (l ∉ region)
      issued := (region, s.A.length) :: ar.issued })

/-- Outcomes of `issue` (A10): `ok`, defined failure `fail` with the state unchanged, `reject`
(pass-1 arbitrage 6). -/
inductive IOutcome where
  | ok (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | fail (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | reject

/-- `arena.issue` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10): `reject` when a static precondition fails;
`fail`, with the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable; `reject` when the region is
available but `internal` lacks the right to distribute it; `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive IssueStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
    IOutcome → Prop where
  | ok : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s
        (.ok (issueEff s ar region dst).1 (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
  | fail : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → ¬ Avail ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s ar)
  | reject : ¬ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
  | noRight : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → ¬ IssueRight s ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject

/-- Determinism of `issue` (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
theorem issue_det {k : K} {ar : Arena} {via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s : S3}
    {o₁ o₂ : IOutcome} (h₁ : IssueStep k ar via region dst s o₁)

    IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.ok s' ar') ↔ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst ∧
      Avail ar region ∧ IssueRight s ar region ∧ (s', ar') = issueEff s ar region dst := by

/-- Preconditions of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right; no active authority
derived from `internal`; no usable place anchored on `internal` or on an authority derived from

def ResetPre (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ar.internal ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, x ≠ ar.internal ∧ ar.internal ∉ s.ancs x)

/-- Effect of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): the whole storage becomes available, the past
emissions are forgotten, the metadata become `Init`. -/
def resetEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : S3 × Arena :=

  Guarded (ResetPre k s ar via) (resetEff s ar)

/-- `AnchorOrder` read on the places of `P`: decidable form. -/
theorem anchorOrder_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrder s ↔

  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩

/-- `NoDangling` read on the authorities of `A` and on the places containing each covered leaf:
decidable form. -/
theorem noDangling_iff {s : S3} : NoDangling s ↔
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active j → ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l < s.P.length → isLeaf s.P l →
      ∀ q ∈ l :: chain (parentOf s.P) l, s.Usable q := by
  constructor
  · intro h j _ ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ l hl hlP hleaf q hq
    have hl' : l ∈ y.footprint := by simpa [S3.afp, hy] using hl
    exact Decidable.byContradiction fun hu => h j y hy ya q hu l
      (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlP, (List.mem_cons.1 hq).imp Eq.symm id⟩) hl'
  · intro h j y hy ya q hu l hl hly
    obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf, -, hq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
    exact hu (h j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy)) ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ l
      (by simp only [S3.afp, hy]; exact hly) hlP hleaf q (List.mem_cons.2 (hq.imp Eq.symm id)))

/-- I4 holds in every state: the read condition requires `Init` (MM-03.3 §2, I4; §5). -/
theorem i4_always (s : S3) : I4 s := fun _ _ hm h => by rw [h.2.1] at hm; cases hm

/-- Root place (MM-03.3.2; B1): an existing place without parent. -/
def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none

instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- First clause of B1: two distinct root places have disjoint footprints. Parts and their
containing places are not concerned. -/
def RootsDisjoint (P : List Place) : Prop :=
  ∀ r r', RootPlace P r → RootPlace P r' → r ≠ r' → ∀ l ∈ footprint P r, l ∉ footprint P r'

/-- Second clause of B1: the chain of origins of an authority covering a leaf ends at the root
authority of the root place of that leaf, an authority without origin whose footprint is the
footprint of that root place. -/
def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- A4, "Une racine reste détenue par le propriétaire de son emplacement", a possession condition
that A1 keeps in `WF3`: an authority without origin is held by the owner of the root place of
every leaf it covers. -/
def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner

/-- `WF3` (A1, A4, B1, C3): well-formedness, the domain of admissible states, separate from the
safety invariant `Inv3`. Origins precede their derivations; footprints are made of existing
places; the stack is non-empty and without duplicates, below `nF`; owner frames are below `nF`;
owner places exist; a part comes after its parent and has its owner and its `dead` flag; every
active authority has a live holder (possession); B1: the chain of origins of an authority covering
a leaf ends at the root authority of its root place (`RootChain`); A4: a root is held by the owner
of its place (`RootHeld`). C3: the first clause of B1, `RootsDisjoint`, is not a clause: it holds
for every list of places (`rootsDisjoint_always`). -/
def WF3 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  (∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b) ∧
  (∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, l < s.P.length) ∧
  s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ (∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF) ∧
  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f → f < s.nF) ∧
  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
    o < s.P.length) ∧
  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q) ∧
  (∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → HolderLive s y.holder) ∧
  RootChain s ∧ RootHeld s

theorem exitFrame_kills_owned {k : K} {s s' : S3} {f : Nat} {F₀ : Frames} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (hF : s.F = f :: F₀) (h : ExitStep k s (.ok s')) :

def partOf (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop :=
  p < P.length ∧ (p = q ∨ q ∈ chain (parentOf P) p)

instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (partOf P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- Storage leaf (MM-03.3.2): a place without a strict part. -/
def isLeaf (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Prop := ∀ r < P.length, parentOf P r ≠ some l

instance (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Decidable (isLeaf P l) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _, _))

/-- `footprint P q` (MM-03.3.2): the leaves of `P` that are parts of `q`. -/
def footprint (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun l => decide (isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q)

/-- Two places overlap when their footprints share a leaf (MM-03.3.2). -/
def overlap (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ∃ l ∈ footprint P p, l ∈ footprint P q

instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (overlap P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃ _ ∈ _, _))

/-- Structural disjointness (MM-03.3.2): neither path is a part of the other. -/
def structurallyDisjoint (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ¬ partOf P p q ∧ ¬ partOf P q p

instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (structurallyDisjoint P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

theorem mem_footprint {P : List Place} {q l : Nat} :
    l ∈ footprint P q ↔ l < P.length ∧ isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q := by
  simp [footprint, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]

theorem footprint_congr {P P' : List Place} (hlen : P'.length = P.length)
    (hpar : parentOf P' = parentOf P) (q : Nat) : footprint P' q = footprint P q := by
  unfold footprint; rw [hlen]; congr 1; funext l
  exact decide_eq_decide.2 (by simp only [isLeaf, partOf, hpar, hlen])

namespace Ern.MM03

-- (A) MMIO cases: are the rejects due to the pinning? Same ops under K0 (nothing pinned).
example : TransferStep K0 0 1 mm0 (.ok (transferEff mm0 0 1)) := .ok (by decide)
example : EndUseStep K0 0 mm0 (.ok (endUseEff mm0 0)) := .ok (by decide)

#eval (decide (MetaRight K0 (endUseEff b4 2) arB 2),
       decide ((endUseEff b4 2).Active arB.internal),
       decide (∀ l ∈ [5], l ∈ (endUseEff b4 2).afp arB.internal),
       decide ((endUseEff b4 2).Usable 3),
       decide (HasRight (endUseEff b4 2) .modify 3),
       decide (∀ l ∈ footprint (endUseEff b4 2).P 3, (endUseEff b4 2).I l ≠ .init))

-- (C) nested arena: endUse of the (shared) arena value kills the parent too.
example : EndUseStep K0 0 nA5 (.ok (endUseEff nA5 0)) := .ok (by decide)
example : ¬ (endUseEff nA5 0).Active 2 := by decide
example : ResetAtStep K0 0 0 (endUseEff nA5 0) .reject := .reject (by decide)
-- block issued to another value (place 1) : newArena on its region rejected
def nB4 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff (write3Eff nA3 [1]) arP [3] 1).1 0 (issueEff (write3Eff nA3 [1]) arP [3] 1).2
#eval decide (IssueStatic K0 nA3 arP 0 [3] 1)
#eval (decide (NewArenaStep 3 nA4 (.ok nA5)))

example : ∀ statics, ¬ Reachable K0 statics ao2 := fun statics hr =>
  absurd ((reachable_access_invariant_underDD (KT_dd [] [] [] [] []) hr).2.1.ao)
    (fun h => absurd (h 0 (by decide) 5 (by decide)) (by decide))

#eval dd1.F

-- (G) write on whole container rejected because of block 7 on leaf 4

end Ern.MM03

/-- static 1 is owned by static 0 (owning element). -/
def stO : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true), ((none, some 0, 0), false)]
#eval (S3.init stO).P.map (·.owner)
#eval decide (ShapeOK 0 (stO.map (·.1)))

/-- A state where static 1 is owned by the frame-1 place 2: it satisfies the whole conclusion of
`reachable_base_owns_statics` for `stO`, yet frame 0 does not own static 1. -/
def tO : S3 := { S3.init stO with F := [1, 0], nF := 2,
  P := [⟨none, .frame 0, 0⟩, ⟨none, .place 2, 0⟩, ⟨none, .frame 1, 0⟩] }

example : tO.F.getLast? = some 0 ∧ 0 < tO.nF ∧ stO.length ≤ tO.P.length ∧
    ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place), tO.P[q]? = some pl →
      (pl.owner = .frame 0 ↔ q < stO.length ∧ ((stO.map (·.1))[q]?).bind (·.2.1) = none) := by
  refine ⟨rfl, by decide, by decide, fun q pl hq => ?_⟩
  match q, hq with
  | 0, hq => cases hq; decide
  | 1, hq => cases hq; decide
  | 2, hq => cases hq; decide

example : ¬ OwnedByFrame tO.P 0 1 := by
  intro h
  cases h with
  | frame hpl ho => cases hpl; cases ho
  | place hpl ho h2 =>
    cases hpl; cases ho
    cases h2 with
    | frame hpl ho => cases hpl; cases ho
    | place hpl ho _ => cases hpl; cases ho

example : Read3Step 1 [1] dd0 .reject := .reject (by decide)

end Ern.MM03

/-- Sufficient conditions for the arena invariant to carry over to a new state: existing
authorities keep mode and footprint, only lose activity, keep an origin equal to `internal` or
absent; the storage stays an owned root; `internal` stays held by the owner of the storage. -/
theorem arenaInv_transport {s s' : S3} {ar : Arena} (hai : ArenaInv s ar)
    (hA : ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → ∃ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧
      y'.mode = y.mode ∧ y'.footprint = y.footprint ∧ (y'.active = true → y.active = true) ∧
      (y.origin = some ar.internal → y'.origin = some ar.internal) ∧
      (y.origin = none → y'.origin = none))
    (hroot : OwnedStorage s' ar.storage)
    (hown : ∀ (y y' : Authority) (pl : Place), s.A[ar.internal]? = some y →
      s'.A[ar.internal]? = some y' → s.P[ar.storage]? = some pl → y.holder = pl.owner →
      ∃ pl', s'.P[ar.storage]? = some pl' ∧ y'.holder = pl'.owner)
    (hfoot : ∀ l, l ∈ footprint s'.P ar.storage ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P ar.storage) :
    ArenaInv s' ar := by
  obtain ⟨c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, -, ⟨yi, pli, hyi, hpli, hmi, hhi⟩, c7⟩ := hai
  obtain ⟨yi', hyi', mi, fi, -, -, -⟩ := hA _ yi hyi
  have hafp : s'.afp ar.internal = s.afp ar.internal := by simp [S3.afp, hyi, hyi', fi]
  have act : ∀ x, s'.Active x → x < s.A.length → s.Active x := fun x ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ hx => by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y := ⟨_, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.2 ⟨hx, rfl⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨y'', hy'', -, -, ha, -⟩ := hA x y hy
    rw [hy'] at hy''; cases hy''; exact ⟨y, hy, ha ya'⟩

findings.title: The nested-arena case of task §5 cannot be built as written. The module tests a different scenario (release instead of endUse), and D3 makes the child and parent arenas always share one arena value
findings.location: formal/Ern/MM03.lean:8430-8470 (nA0..nA5, nested_reachable); interaction of D3 with WF3 at line 1557
findings.evidence: Task §5 asks for a child arena on a block of the parent, with reset of the parent giving reject while the child lives and `ok après endUse de l'enfant et de son bloc`. D3 requires `internal` to be held by the owner of `storage`. WF3 (line 1557) forces a part to have its parent's owner (`pr.owner = pl.owner`). So the block region's place is always owned by the parent arena value, and newArena only succeeds when the block was issued to that same value. I checked this in Lean (scratchpad rev10/stmt/checks2.lean). In a fresh run, the parent issues block [4] to another Uninit local 2 (IssueAt ... (.ok nC4) builds), and then both `NewArenaStep 4 nC4 .reject` and `NewArenaStep 2 nC4 .reject` hold. In the module's own realisation, endUse of the child's arena value also ends the parent (checks.lean): `EndUseStep K0 0 nA5 (.ok (endUseEff nA5 0))`, `¬ (endUseEff nA5 0).Active 2` and `ResetAtStep K0 0 0 (endUseEff nA5 0) .reject` all build. The brief's expected `ok` after endUse therefore cannot be obtained. The module replaces it with `ReleaseStep 3 nA5` (line 8452) and then reset ok. This confirms implementer claim (7), but the case's verdict as specified is not met. A broader consequence the arbiter should see: under D3, nested arenas cannot have their own value, so transfer or endUse of one moves or ends both.
findings.suggested_fix: Put this to arbitration: either relax D3's holder requirement for nested arenas, or reword the §5 case to 'release of the child's internal'. Until then, record the substituted scenario in report sections (d) and (g) as a deviation from the task case.

findings.title: reachable_base_owns_statics does not state that statics with an owning element stay owned by frame 0
findings.evidence: Brief step 1: `reachable_base_owns_nothing est réénoncé : le cadre 0 possède exactement les emplacements statiques et leur stockage possédé`. The new conclusion only says `pl.owner = .frame 0 ↔ q < statics.length ∧ (owning element) = none`, which is direct ownership. For a static whose encoding has an owning element, it says nothing. In Lean (rev10/stmt/checks3.lean) I took `stO := [((none,none,0),true), ((none,some 0,0),false)]` (ShapeOK holds, and S3.init gives owners [frame 0, place 0]). A state `tO` where static 1 is owned by `.place 2`, and place 2 by frame 1, satisfies all four conjuncts of the conclusion, yet `¬ OwnedByFrame tO.P 0 1` is provable. So the theorem does not exclude a static leaving frame 0's ownership, and the 'every static place is owned by frame 0' half of 'exactement' is unproven for owned statics. No pass-5 test uses an owned static either.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the conjunct `∀ q < statics.length, OwnedByFrame s.P 0 q`, by proving an invariant that statics stay transitively owned by frame 0. Otherwise, list this direction as unproven in the report.

findings.title: ao2_rejected_at_depend now rules out reachability only from the empty static storage, though the same proof works for every static storage
findings.evidence: The statement changed from `¬ Reachable K0 ao2` to `¬ Reachable K0 [] ao2`, and likewise for `exitEff ao2`. With `S3.init statics`, 'ao2 is not reached' now means for every statics, not just []. The pass-4 meaning carries over at no cost: this builds in rev10/stmt/checks.lean: `example : ∀ statics, ¬ Reachable K0 statics ao2 := fun statics hr => absurd ((reachable_access_invariant_underDD (KT_dd [] [] [] [] []) hr).2.1.ao) (fun h => absurd (h 0 (by decide) 5 (by decide)) (by decide))`. Narrowing to [] is not forced by the brief. Brief (o) asks for such domain changes to be listed.
findings.suggested_fix: Restate both negative conjuncts as `∀ statics, ¬ Reachable K0 statics _` (the helper `unr` already works for any statics), or list the narrowing in report section (o).

findings.title: Dependency-only return case: the docstring gives the wrong indices, and the read-reject verdict would also hold before the call
findings.evidence: The docstring says 'the call passes 4, which observes the part 1, and 5, which modifies the result; the callee value 6 depends on 4 and is returned to 3'. `#eval dd1.A` gives [(none,[1,2],modify), (none,[3],modify), (some 0,[1],observe), (some 1,[3],modify), (none,[4],modify)] and `dd1.P.length = 5`. The definitions are `enterEff … [2, 3] …`, `dependEff … 4 2` and `transferEff dd2 4 3`. So the parameters are authorities 2 and 3, and the callee value is place 4, depending on authority 2. Separately, `Read3Step 1 [1] dd0 .reject` also builds (checks3.lean): authority 1 (root of place 3, footprint [3]) never covered leaf 1, so the reject verdict does not depend on the return scenario. Only the companion `decide` check (no active authority covering leaf 1 is held by place 3) carries the case's content.
findings.suggested_fix: Fix the indices in the docstring (params 2 and 3, callee value 4, depends on 2). State that the verdict rests on the 'no authority held by 3' check, or move that fact into the verdict example.

findings.title: arenaInv_transport keeps a hypothesis conjunct it no longer uses, and its docstring still says 'owned root'
findings.evidence: `hA` still requires `(y.origin = none → y'.origin = none)`. Once ArenaInv dropped `y.origin = none` for internal, every destructuring in the proof discards that conjunct: `obtain ⟨yi', hyi', mi, fi, -, -, -⟩ := hA _ yi hyi`, `obtain ⟨y'', hy'', -, -, ha, -⟩ := hA x y hy` and `obtain ⟨y', hy', m', f', -, o', -⟩ := hA _ y hy`. The statement therefore carries an unjustified hypothesis (AGENTS.md: never add an unjustified hypothesis). The docstring still reads 'keep an origin equal to `internal` or absent; the storage stays an owned root', while the hypothesis is now `OwnedStorage`.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the unused conjunct from `hA` (and from callers), and update the docstring to 'storage owned by a place' and 'origin equal to internal'.
